description: Run a .PR program and save output as a persistent .R file in S3

report_name.description: Custom base name for output files. Defaults to the program name. Output is saved as output/{report_name}.R (plus .pdf/.csv/.json/.xlsx when format is set). Must not contain path separators or '..'.

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_export_report
